title: Duplex in Decatur
description: Two units on a quiet street, both rented to long-term tenants. The bank will carry most of it.

title: Starter Condo
description: One bedroom near the hospital. Nurses rent it on rotating contracts, so it is rarely empty.

title: Lawn Care Trailer
description: A used trailer, two mowers, and a list of eight weekly customers. You hire a high-schooler to run it.

title: Total Market Index Fund
description: A slice of every big company at once. Slow, boring, and it pays a small dividend every month.

title: Birchwood Robotics Shares
description: A young company that builds warehouse robots. The price swings; buy low if you can.

title: Vending Machine Route
description: Six snack machines in office lobbies. You restock them on Saturdays and keep the coins.

title: Lakeshore Utilities Shares
description: The power company. Nobody gets rich on it, but it pays a dividend every month like clockwork.
